info.title: Regime Card: market regime and risk-on / risk-off API
info.summary: A market regime and market risk check for AI agents. Pay per call in USDC over x402, or connect the MCP server. No account, no API key.
info.description: Is the US market risk-on or risk-off right now? Regime Card reads eight cross-asset signals (credit, volatility, rates, currencies, commodities, sectors) and answers with one score from 0 to 100 and one of five market regimes, from Risk-Off to Risk-On. Agents use it as a market conditions check, a macro signal, or a risk check before a trade. Also: the stress gate, and how a stock or crypto has typically done in markets like today's. Pay per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana over x402. No account, no API key. Each settled regime reading is added to a public, hash-linked record the day it is published; a correction is a new entry, never an edit.
info.x-guidance: Regime Card describes US market conditions: a percentile from 0 (most risk-off) to 100 (most risk-on), one of five regimes, a stress gate, and how stocks and coins have typically done in the current regime. Start with the free sample. Paid calls cost a few cents in USDC over x402 and return data only after the payment settles. Every response says whether it is live or settled. It describes conditions and is not investment advice.

get.summary: Get the live US market regime reading: risk-on or risk-off
get.description: Is the US market risk-on or risk-off right now? Returns the live Regime Card reading: a percentile from 0 (most risk-off) to 100 (most risk-on) and one of five market regimes, from Risk-Off to Risk-On, built from eight cross-asset signals, beside the last settled close. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). post.summary: Fetch one stock or crypto symbol's returns by market regime
post.description: How has this stock or crypto typically done in markets like today's? Returns, for one stock or crypto symbol per call (any US stock, plus the covered crypto list), its typical return and how often it rose over 1 to 12 months from the current regime. Stocks add sensitivity versus the S&P 500 and up to 5 peer symbols. A symbol with no price data is free. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Settled figures, updated after each US close (coins daily). The same figures as the symbol's page on regimecard.com. Useful when an agent needs a stock lookup: stock data, stock returns by market regime or crypto returns by market regime.

Rescanned each morning before the US open; prices refresh during the US session. "stale" is true when a scheduled rescan is missing. Useful when an agent needs an earnings surprise check, post-earnings announcement drift data or an earnings calendar follow-up for stocks.

200.description: Returns the Regime Card post-earnings drift (PEAD) tracker: large US stocks that reported earnings in about the last two weeks, in the tracker's own order, each with its report date, its earnings surprise, its first-session reaction and its price drift since the report.

asOf.description: The day of the tracker's newest scan (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: "live": prices were refreshed within the current US session. "settled": the newest scan and the last prices before it.

updatedAt.description: When the list or its prices were last updated (UTC).

stale.description: True when the tracker has not been rescanned on schedule.

rank.description: Its place in the tracker's own order, 1 first.

reportDate.description: The day the company reported earnings (YYYY-MM-DD).

reportTime.description: Whether it reported before the US open or after the close. Null when not known.

daysSinceReport.description: Calendar days from the report to asOf.

epsSurprisePct.description: Reported earnings per share against the analyst estimate, in percent of the estimate.

reactionPct.description: The first session after the report: its close against the last close before the report, in percent.

driftPct.description: The move since the report: the latest price against the last close before the report, in percent.

sinceReactionPct.description: The move after the first session: the latest price against that session's close, in percent.

driftVsDailyRange.description: driftPct as a multiple of the stock's average daily range before the report.

stocks.description: The stocks in their post-earnings window, in the tracker's own order. Facts about each report and the price move since. The order's formula stays private.

related.description: The other paid routes: for each, its path, the question it answers and its price per call. Each is a separate call.

path.description: The route's path on this origin.

priceUsd.description: The price in US dollars, paid in USDC.

per.description: What the price is for: one call, or each covered symbol of one call.

research.description: A published Regime Card study of the current regime. Present only when one exists for it.

verify.description: The page that explains the hash chain and checks every entry in the browser.

ledger.description: Every entry as JSON, each with the hash of the entry before it.

covers.description: The reading it covers: the percentile and the regime label of each daily settled reading, and nothing else in this response.

note.description: The same facts in one plain sentence.
note.const: Each settled regime reading is added to a public, hash-linked record the day it is published; a correction is a new entry, never an edit.

record.description: The public, hash-linked record of the daily settled regime reading: its percentile and its regime label. It covers nothing else in this response: not the stress gate, stock or coin figures, the scorecard, or a live intraday reading. The same on every response.

disclaimer.const: For informational purposes only. Not investment advice.
